about.description: Short names of the registers’ activities, for the Index page’s company card: NACE Rev. 2 classes, divisions and sections (Sirene, and the Diputació de Barcelona’s census by CCAE), the NACE Rev. 2.1 classes whose code means something else (Brønnøysund, SN2025), and the Spanish CNAE-2009’s own classes. Written from the official titles (Statistics Norway’s Klass, in English, for NACE Rev. 2 and 2.1).
